entities.summary: Amīn-ad-Daula Abu-'l-Faraǧ ibn Yaʻqūb ibn Isḥāq Ibn al-Quff al-Karaki was an Arab physician and surgeon and writer of the earliest and largest medieval Arabic treatise intended solely for surgeons.
